title: Purgatorio Seven-Terrace / Narcissism Relationship Reconciliation
ownerDirection: Narcissism has seven layers in the 40–60 middle band, where the person oscillates.
documentedCanonicalDistinction: The seven current Purgatorio records are vice-to-capacity oscillation terraces; narcissism exists separately in the deeper psychological complex research. No verified one-to-one mapping is yet established.

behavioralOscillation.trigger: Correction, another person receiving credit, losing face, public uncertainty, or comparison to an expert.
behavioralOscillation.defensiveMotion: EXPAND self-image → CONCEAL fallibility → REPEL correction → HOLD position.
behavioralOscillation.constructiveMotion: RECEIVE correction → RELEASE status defense → CONNECT as equals → EXPRESS responsibility.
behavioralOscillation.cycle: Status threat → defensive self-elevation → short relief → damaged mutual trust → more vigilance about rank.
observableEvidence: Claims special standing, redirects credit, dismisses criticism, hides mistakes, or insists on being right to preserve rank.
Acknowledges what is true, credits others, asks for correction, admits limits, and holds equal regard without shrinking.
behavioralOscillation.behavioralCompletion: In an actual status threat, receives feedback, credits another, corrects course, and can repeat this without rank restoration.

behavioralOscillation.trigger: A peer succeeds, receives attention, is loved, or gains a resource I wanted.
behavioralOscillation.defensiveMotion: SEEK comparison → CONTRACT possibility → REPEL another’s good → WITHDRAW warmth.
behavioralOscillation.constructiveMotion: RECEIVE another’s good → EXPAND possibility → CONNECT → EXPRESS kindness.
behavioralOscillation.cycle: Comparison cue → scarcity belief → devaluation or withdrawal → temporary control → increased comparison.
observableEvidence: Keeps score, discounts achievements, gossips, withdraws goodwill, or gains relief when a rival fails.
Recognizes another person’s good, offers genuine goodwill or help, and acts toward one’s own values without rivalry.
behavioralOscillation.behavioralCompletion: Can witness a peer’s success without punishment, support their success where appropriate, and keep a clear personal path.

behavioralOscillation.trigger: Perceived disrespect, threat, betrayal, obstruction, unfair treatment, or loss of control.
behavioralOscillation.defensiveMotion: CONTRACT threat focus → INITIATE attack → PENETRATE boundary → HOLD grievance.
behavioralOscillation.constructiveMotion: HOLD a pause → RECEIVE facts → EXPRESS firm boundary → RELEASE retaliation.
behavioralOscillation.cycle: Threat interpretation → surge or freeze → retaliatory move → short sense of control → worsened threat field.
observableEvidence: Escalates voice or force, assigns hostile intent before checking, attacks character, seeks revenge, or goes into resentful silence.
Names the harm and boundary directly, maintains restraint, listens for reality, and chooses proportionate action.
behavioralOscillation.behavioralCompletion: During real provocation, sets limits without humiliation, violence, or prolonged retaliation and repairs harm when needed.

behavioralOscillation.trigger: Overwhelm, fear of failure, uncertain payoff, monotony, fatigue, shame, or too-large commitments.
behavioralOscillation.defensiveMotion: AVOID difficulty → WITHDRAW initiative → HOLD imagined failure → PRESERVE stuckness.
behavioralOscillation.constructiveMotion: RECEIVE capacity limits → INITIATE small action → PRESERVE continuity → EXPAND agency.
behavioralOscillation.cycle: Demand → hopeless forecast → avoidance → immediate relief → rising burden → renewed avoidance.
observableEvidence: Repeatedly delays chosen action, escapes into distraction, passively agrees while not starting, or abandons meaningful commitments.
Begins a viable action, stays with a manageable commitment, requests necessary support, and returns after interruption.
behavioralOscillation.behavioralCompletion: Repeatedly begins chosen, appropriately sized action under uncertainty and uses recovery without self-attack.

behavioralOscillation.trigger: Fear of loss, comparison, insecurity, sudden money, status pressure, or opportunity to control through resources.
behavioralOscillation.defensiveMotion: ATTACH to resource → HOLD or DISRUPT its flow → CONTRACT safety to possession → REPEL reciprocity.
behavioralOscillation.constructiveMotion: PRESERVE essentials → RECEIVE enough → RELEASE unnecessary control → CONNECT through fair exchange.
behavioralOscillation.cycle: Loss cue → possession-as-safety belief → hoard or prove worth through spending → short relief → deeper insecurity.
observableEvidence: Hoarding beyond needs or spending to secure approval; leverages possession for control; sacrifices trust to acquisition.
Meets responsibilities, budgets realistically, shares without coercion, and uses resources for actual values and relationships.
behavioralOscillation.behavioralCompletion: Makes sustainable resource decisions under scarcity cues, honors obligations, and gives freely only within real capacity.

behavioralOscillation.trigger: Stress, emptiness, boredom, reward cues, loneliness, uncertainty, or fatigue.
behavioralOscillation.defensiveMotion: SEEK relief → APPROACH substitute → HOLD repetition → AVOID underlying feeling.
behavioralOscillation.constructiveMotion: RECEIVE signal → DIFFERENTIATE need from substitute → HOLD enough → RELEASE compulsive repetition.
behavioralOscillation.cycle: Discomfort → substitute intake → short relief → unmet need persists → repeat.
observableEvidence: Repeatedly consumes or seeks stimulation past a chosen useful limit while the underlying need remains unaddressed.
Names the need, enjoys pleasure consciously, recognizes enough, and stops or changes course when appropriate.
behavioralOscillation.behavioralCompletion: Experiences discomfort or appetite, accurately distinguishes needs, and chooses sufficient behavior without harsh deprivation.

behavioralOscillation.trigger: Attraction, rejection, boredom, fear of intimacy, insecurity, novelty, or relationship conflict.
behavioralOscillation.defensiveMotion: ATTRACT validation → PENETRATE boundaries → CONCEAL need → AVOID genuine intimacy.
behavioralOscillation.constructiveMotion: RECEIVE desire → DIFFERENTIATE self from other → CONNECT consensually → HOLD respect.
behavioralOscillation.cycle: Worth threat or craving → pursuit of validation through another → short relief → loneliness or conflict → renewed pursuit.
observableEvidence: Uses seduction to control, obscures intentions, pressures boundaries, treats people as sources of validation, or pursues repeated novelty despite harm.
Feels desire without coercion, communicates intentions, checks consent, respects refusal, and integrates sexuality with care.
behavioralOscillation.behavioralCompletion: Responds to attraction or rejection with consent, candor, reciprocal care, and preserved autonomy.
